CustomField.description: Body exactly as received. Stored verbatim because the HMAC is computed over the raw bytes - reserialising changes whitespace and key order and invalidates the signature. GUEST-SENSITIVE: carries reporter and assignee PII from Jira. STORAGE: written for rejected requests too, so an unauthenticated caller can grow this object; revisit before exposing the endpoint publicly.
CustomField.label: Raw Payload
